readout_other: camcorder recording of induced tail, digit, mouth and tongue movement
direction_notes: Tail, finger, thumb, jaw, lower lip and tongue movements were induced depending on focus position (200 um steps); response delay averaged 12 s.
safety_notes: A 2D Pennes bioheat simulation gave a temperature rise of about 0.5 C at the focus after 60 s; no in vivo safety assessment is described.

exposures.label: Phased-array UNMOD of monkey motor cortex (tail, hand, mouth areas)

target.label: primary motor cortex areas related to tail, hand, and mouth

timing.protocol_description: Each stimulation was 1 min at a 5% duty factor and 100 Hz PRF; the focus was electronically steered in 200 um steps around reference points, with stimulation off for about 1 min between points.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The induction of high-resolution UNMOD was conducted on two subjects.
